title: Sternal ECG Patch Comparison Trial
brief_summary: This study is intended to compare the new Carnation Ambulatory Monitoring (CAM) System, a patch monitoring system, with the Holter monitoring system. Holters represent the current standard for continuous recording of the ECG over extended periods.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Syncope of uncertain etiology or
* Pre-syncope of uncertain etiology or
* Palpitations of uncertain etiology or
* Management of known AF/SVT patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any dermatitis or infected skin over the sternum (Carnation patch) or left upper anterior thorax (Zio patch).
* A sternal or thoracic incision that extends under the patch within 3 months from the date of enrollment
study_population: Cardiac patients at Auckland City Hospital, Auckland, New Zealand
